purpose: Preserve every historical DreamCo goal, approved plan, requirement, dependency, and unfinished task until evidence-backed mastery or an explicit user-directed disposition.
operating_rules: Never delete a historical goal merely because it is duplicated; link duplicates to one canonical implementation while preserving source references.
Never mark a goal mastered from documentation, file counts, mock output, or an unverified assistant claim.
Reopen mastered goals when regressions, drift, new requirements, or failed monitoring appear.
Continue the next safe, dependency-unblocked task; keep blocked work visible with its blocker and required decision.
Run read-only audits and local tests automatically; require human approval for production releases, destructive changes, paid compute, billing, credentials, permissions, and external data actions.
User approval of a plan does not authorize merge, deployment, spending, or safety bypass.
Historical conversation and PR reconciliation remains an explicit workstream until every discovered requirement has a source reference and disposition.

Preserve Python as canonical source of truth; retain the existing C and Swift candidates without modifying them during this phase. Reconcile all relevant current-thread requirements, historical goal records, open and closed PRs, branches, workflows, issues, registries, datasets, databases, storage, queues, training, tokenizer, model identities, benchmarks, governance, security, recovery, dashboards, integrations, and revenue plans.
acceptance: current conversation requirements captured as stable goal records without copying private chat transcripts or secrets
historical source inventory and known coverage limitations explicitly recorded
every open and relevant closed PR has a disposition: merge candidate, superseded with provenance, blocked, or intentionally retained
all main-repository workflows and recurring schedules inventoried with current run evidence and failure ownership
all 65 division identities and per-division database, dataset, tokenizer, model, checkpoint, training, benchmark, and serving contracts traced to implementations and tests
real PostgreSQL, object storage, task queue, workers, training compute, teacher/provider access, and secrets are either verified with safe evidence or retained as explicitly blocked dependencies
actual tokenizer training and model-weight training are distinguished from planning, dry-runs, mocks, and structural validation
Buddy Bootcamp curriculum and teacher resources cover the approved Hugging Face taxonomy with source snapshots, mapped ownership, and unresolved-owner review
benchmark suites include private holdouts, safety, privacy, robustness, regression, latency, throughput, memory, cost, and reproducibility evidence
production, privacy, security, backup/restore, rollback, observability, and human approval gates pass without bypass
main-repository public/private dashboards and status reports reflect real evidence and distinguish planned, running, blocked, and completed work
all Python-first release gates are satisfied and independently reviewed before any C or Swift repository implementation work begins
later C and Swift competition uses versioned shared contracts, identical task fixtures, recorded hardware, and comparable evidence

Python, C, and Swift receive equal compute budgets and identical benchmark conditions within comparable laptop and GitHub runner cohorts; every attempt and failure is retained and no candidate receives hidden advantages
division-private data, databases, checkpoints, and evaluation holdouts remain isolated by default; shared corpora are immutable, rights/privacy-reviewed, scoped, and provenance-tracked

workstreams.name: First-party DreamCo training corpus and Bootcamp data factory
workstreams.scope: Build original DreamCo-authored teaching and task datasets, a governed multi-ecosystem source registry, reproducible per-division corpus materialization, and a training-data factory for Buddy Teacher and all 65 MasterBot lanes. Preserve rights, provenance, privacy, quality, split isolation, model lineage, and evidence for every source and transformation.
acceptance: original DreamCo Bootcamp seed lessons have stable IDs, answer rubrics, provenance, source version, split assignments, and explicit human-review/rights status
candidate builder deterministically materializes common foundation data into all 65 isolated MasterBot dataset lanes without sharing private division data or evaluation holdouts
all candidate manifests pin source, output, and train/validation/test hashes and are reproducible from a fixed commit

source registry covers first-party work, official technical documentation, public dataset catalogs, research metadata, code repositories, government/standards data, user contributions, teacher outputs, and evaluation-only resources beyond Hugging Face
metadata discovery is distinct from download, ingestion, training permission, and commercial redistribution permission
license, file-level rights, privacy/consent, PII/secrets, duplicate, quality, contamination, and split-isolation gates run before any dataset can be approved
division-specialist datasets have one primary owner and explicit collaborator grants; shared foundation assets use immutable references and per-division materialization
Buddy can select the best eligible teacher/model and dataset using capability, rights, privacy, quality, freshness, cost, and latency evidence
teacher outputs are training inputs only when provider/account terms and output-use permissions are explicitly verified
dataset registration does not imply training; actual weight updates require the separate approved compute workflow, pinned base/tokenizer, checkpoint hashes, and independent holdout benchmarks
the factory can produce reproducible candidate datasets for Buddy Teacher and 65 divisions, with blocked and unreviewed assets visibly excluded
